reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-prisoner-swap-trump-envoy-kushner-witkoff-b3083499.html) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to their biggest prisoner swap yet at the Abu Dhabi peace summit.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-envoys-jared-kushner-and-steve-witkoff-arrive-in-russia-for-latest-round-of-ukraine-peace-talks-with-vladimir-putin-101794470586213.html) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow for Ukraine peace talks with Putin, and will subsequently fly to Dublin to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZjMaLSVR6/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Russia and Ukraine struck a major prisoner swap deal in Abu Dhabi.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZga98dQA0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported a source in the Russian negotiating group stated that trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine ended in Abu Dhabi.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177706) reported that US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived at Vnukovo airport in Moscow to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/kremlin-aide-calls-abu-dhabi-ukraine-talks-substantive-3725471) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov described two days of US-mediated trilateral Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi as substantive and quite useful.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-reports-major-progress-in-russia-peace-talks) reported that Ukraine's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov stated negotiations with Russia yielded significant progress on security and economic prosperity.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/russia-and-ukraine-say-some-progress-made-talks-us-cites-lack-trust) reported that Russian and Ukrainian negotiators reported some progress in two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/russia-refused-to-discuss-ceasefire-or-territorial-issues-on-second-day-of-abu-dhabi-peace-talks-shifting-focus-to-european-security-architecture-rbc-ukraine-reports) reported that the Russian delegation refused to discuss territorial issues, a ceasefire, energy, or Black Sea security on the second day of talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/witkoff-and-kushner-arrive-in-moscow-for-talks-with-putin) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, arrived in Moscow on the morning of November 12.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/11/abu-dhabi-talks-end-with-prisoner-exchange-but-no-peace-breakthrough-a94227) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to carry out a major exchange of prisoners in the coming days despite persistent differences in negotiation positions.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/emisarios-trump-negocian-putin-moscu-otra-noche-misiles-drones_202611126af574ed9a31a65adcd94edd.html) reported that Moscow launched multiple ballistic missiles and 123 long-range drones against Kyiv and other areas of Ukraine.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/enviados-de-eeuu-viajan-a-moscu-para-reunirse-con-putin-tras-conversaciones-en-abu-dabi_0_GrVpHKcKgE.html) reported that United States representatives met with Russian leadership in Moscow following negotiations in Abu Dhabi regarding a prisoner of war exchange.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/they-re-bringing-something-kushner-and-witkoff-to-meet-putin-in-moscow-day-after-abu-dhabi-peace-talks) reported that U.S. presidential special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow following the Abu Dhabi peace talks.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/11/russia-ukraine-peace-talks-conclude-in-abu-dhabi-with-prisoner-exchange-agreement-but-no-breakthrough-on-territory) reported that the trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States in Abu Dhabi ended with a prisoner exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/russia-and-ukraine-agree-to-a-large-prisoner-exchange-as-talks-conclude-with-no-major-breakthrough) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large prisoner exchange as talks concluded with no major breakthrough.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/11/g-s1-152954/russia-ukraine-war-talks) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war following U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNYTROYzl6bktWaUk4MEdWZXVKN2RYeFR2c0YzMlRtT1VUVW9JZ0hlMklxd0NDYVNtRkdRVTEtV2hZU0pMNlFlNDdESURHcTNMakFYSnlnNEwxbGE3bHVCS2d1dVRuOWhBUmNfYUhXNzE3bVc0VTF2MjluSzhzSThIeWtLSTlEQQ?oc=5) reported that U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks ended with news of good momentum and a large-scale prisoner swap.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQV2RpSFF1Ym9mZkNRLTAyOFVnRk5JbzJmMmEydmFjMl9TS0lBdER0LVNieEZiSWlveXBwdjZtRkZuVWlWalBpdnNlZnZ6RmEtX3A2S0trZFF6OElSa0UyM1IxY1hUd1dnXzZzb2NZRVRkNUxJQmcycHhLN3JhRGo4RUo2N241cHpVeHMxWFlVeENaTFVtYk5GUUR6R3NYX2RxdmthQ0dKNlhKUkprN2tpNDVtVFhfWGVxUHlVbnN0bjRrUDA?oc=5) reported that a Russian negotiator noted some progress after Ukraine talks and stated there is no EU role in the process for now.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/us-brokered-russia-ukraine-talks-abu-dhabi_n_6af43d31e4b09e0b5c534308) reported that envoys from Russia and Ukraine met for four hours in Abu Dhabi for the second day of US-brokered talks.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/russia-ukraine-agree-to-prisoner-swap-at-us-brokered-talks/article71689267.ece) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner swap following US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579894/russia-ukraine-and-us-resume-abu-dhabi-peace-talks/) reported that Russian, Ukrainian, and US officials started the second day of peace talks in Abu Dhabi to explore ways to end the ongoing war.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-9-injure-39-across-ukraine-over-past-day-as-2-russian-cruise-missiles-violate-moldovan-airspace/) reported that Russian forces launched a Kh-59/69 guided missile from the Black Sea and 163 long-range attack drones over the past day, while Moldovan airspace was violated by cruise missiles.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/ukrainian-negotiator-says-peace-talks-with-russia-could-produce-a-deal-before-the-new-year) reported that Davyd Arakhamia stated that participants in the peace talks between Russia and Ukraine could reach a resolution before the end of the year.

[El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-11/las-negociaciones-de-abu-dabi-sobre-ucrania-concluyen-con-un-canje-de-prisioneros-y-sin-progresos-para-la-paz.html) reported that negotiations in Abu Dhabi concluded with a prisoner exchange and without progress toward peace, as the Kremlin pushes to link the invasion with European security reviews.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/11/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-accord-de-principe-avec-la-russie-pour-un-nouvel-echange-de-prisonniers-de-guerre-a-grande-echelle_6808609_3210.html) reported that Vladimir Medinsky announced an agreement in principle with Russia for a large-scale prisoner exchange following the Abu Dhabi talks.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/russia-ukraine-start-second-day-of-us-led-talks-kyiv-lead-negotiator) reported that Russia and Ukraine resumed US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi for a second day, according to Kyiv's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPOTZBa1dKdjVHLWFUdklVcGRSZWMzbUVwVlVPYjVZNUpjbDU0NjBESjhwNEZMUjRtbm9hWGhfRzFZVEFDN0NjU2dKdE5hZmRwajhnWGJUQWdHbkNTOHZkWTM1anlBRFlUU3dXcXlGaXZxcnNuc2NVMHZOUzZBVGVIZGFWaTBWR1VLZmtkb2o1Y1F2dHA3TVhMRlF1OTE?oc=5) reported that Russia pounded Ukraine's power grid as talks opened in Abu Dhabi.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-russia-and-ukraine-wrap-up-abu-dhabi-talks/live-79906232?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that peace talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the US concluded in the United Arab Emirates after two days.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202667/%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B8%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA%D9%83%D9%88%D9%81-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%83%D9%88/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated on Wednesday that he will travel to Moscow on Thursday with U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/abu-dhabi-trilateral-talks-to-end-russia-ukraine-war-enter-2nd-day) reported that Russian, Ukrainian, and U.S. officials held a second day of peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday following constructive meetings.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202543/%D9%84%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A6%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B8%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AB%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7/) reported that Russia, Ukraine, and the United States resumed their trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi for the second consecutive day to discuss ways to end the war.

[BILD](https://www.bild.de/politik/ausland-und-internationales/putins-verlogene-verhandlungen-in-abu-dhabi-reden-sie-in-der-ukraine-bomben-sie-6af428fde22aeb948141f6fd) reported that Moscow attacked Ukraine while peace talks were taking place in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/ukraine-rejects-u-s-proposal-to-redraw-donetsk-and-luhansk-borders-the-telegraph-reports) reported that Ukraine rejected a U.S. proposal to redraw the borders of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/ucrania-e-russia-encerram-segundo-dia-de-negociacao-em-abu-dhabi-sem-anuncios-mas-com-promessa-de-novos-dialogos.ghtml) reported that representatives of the US, Russia, and Ukraine concluded a second day of negotiations in Abu Dhabi without announcements but with a promise of further dialogues.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/11/europe-ukraine-russia-us-talks-abu-dhabi-zelenskyy-latest-news-updates) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is happy with the approach of US envoys as trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia, and the US enter their second day in Abu Dhabi.

Novaya Gazeta Europe reported that the second day of negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States began in Abu Dhabi behind closed doors ([Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/v-abu-dabi-nachalsia-vtoroi-den-peregovorov-rossii-ukrainy-i-ssha-news)).

Ukrinform reported that the second day of trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia on ending the war started in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4183675-second-day-of-trilateral-talks-begins-in-abu-dhabi.html)).

Ukrinform reported that Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in the southern part of the Odesa region overnight, resulting in the death of a woman ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4183660-russian-strikes-hit-energy-infrastructure-in-southern-odesa-region.html)).

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261111-live-ukraine-russia-hold-second-day-of-us-mediated-talks-in-abu-dhabi) reported that Ukraine and Russia held a second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi as Washington called for a new security framework.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mississippis-scott-colom-flips-us-senate-seat-democrat) reported that Scott Colom flipped a US Senate seat to the Democrats in Mississippi.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/mississippi-democrat-flips-us-senate-seat-historic-upset.1136956) reported that senator-elect Scott Colom waved during the conclusion of a victory rally at Tougaloo College.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/mississippi-elege-democrata-scott-colom-primeiro-senador-negro-pelo-estado-dos-eua-em-150-anos.shtml) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won a seat in the United States Senate for Mississippi, becoming the first Black politician to win the seat in 150 years.
[Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/11/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-01161555) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race in an upset.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/republican-house-leader-scalise-jordan.html) reported that House Republicans chose Jim Jordan as their leader and Senate Republicans re-elected John Thune following election losses.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate.html) reported that Bernie Sanders opposed Chuck Schumer as majority leader, with Sanders stating that the time for change is now ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/10/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate-democrats)).

reports.text: [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-3-houthi-cruise-missiles-2-drones-3725474) reported that the Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed three Houthi cruise missiles targeting Riyadh and two drones headed toward Mecca and southern Asir.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/saudi-arabia-intercepts-houthi-missiles-drones-group-denies-targeting-mecca) reported that Saudi air defenses intercepted Houthi missiles and drones launched towards Riyadh, Mecca, and other regions.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-calling-trump-every-day-to-push-for-renewed-war-on-iran/) reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been calling US President Donald Trump every day to urge him to resume military action against Iran.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-treasury-secretary-bessent-relocates-over-iran-threats-3725441) reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has moved to a military base following credible Iranian assassination threats.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uk-agency-reports-tanker-incident-in-strait-of-hormuz-3725440) reported that the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations received a report from military authorities regarding a tanker incident in the Strait of Hormuz.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-reveals-new-underground-missile-city-warning-us) reported that Iran unveiled a secret underground missile city and warned the US and Israel of retaliation beyond the region if attacks resume.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86319077/Two-more-violating-oil-tankers-hit-naval-mines-in-Strait-of-Hormuz), an Iranian state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Navy announced two more violating oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting naval mines.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/photo/86319118/Trump-s-war-on-Iran-will-go-down-as-a-major-fiasco-Schumer), an Iranian state-media outlet, reported that US Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer described US President Donald Trump’s war against Iran as one of the greatest foreign policy failures.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249336/Not-a-particle-of-enriched-nuclear-material-to-be-exited), an Iranian state-media outlet, reported that Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei emphasized Iran will not allow a particle of enriched nuclear material to leave.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/iran-rules-out-uranium-transfer-condemns-us-20m-nuclear-reward) reported that Iran's security chief stated Iran will not allow enriched nuclear material to leave the country, as Tehran condemned a U.S. offer of up to $20 million.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-will-not-allow-enriched-nuclear-material-leave-country-security-chief-says) reported that Iran's security chief stated Iran will not allow a single particle of enriched nuclear material to leave the country and there will be consequences otherwise.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190003/%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B7-%D8%A8%D9%85%D8%B6%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%87%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%B2-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%BA%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A) reported that the Iranian army announced a fire broke out in an oil tanker in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/rubio-urges-nations-to-step-up-on-strait-of-hormuz-security) reported that Marco Rubio urged nations to step up on Strait of Hormuz security and stated the U.S. will continue to defend shipping through the waterway.

[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870538) reported that US President Donald Trump stated the war with Iran is basically over and downplayed concerns about an expanded US offensive.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86318328/Iran-s-IRGC-unveils-new-strategic-missile-city), an Iranian state outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Aerospace Force unveiled a new missile city displaying various advanced missiles.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532026/IRGC-Unveils-New-Underground-Missile-City-in-Show-of-Power) reported that the IRGC Aerospace Force unveiled a new underground missile city displaying ballistic and cruise missiles.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532018/Two-oil-tankers-catch-fire-after-explosions-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that two oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in violation of maritime rules were hit by explosions and caught fire.

reports.text: [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.
